title: Evidence Semantic Reconciliation & Canonical Deduplication
objective: Reconcile canonical Evidence meaning across Financial Position and Key Reports, preserve Programme identity while rendering each associated Programme once, and translate remaining schema language.
implementation_summary: Flora uses one canonical interpretation of supplied Evidence metadata across Financial Position and Key Reports.
Canonical Programme association identity removes repeated traversal output without changing relationships, evidence, lineage, or source counts.
The shared presentation translator removes remaining AI Pressure schema labels while retaining Unknown investment semantics.
expected_visible_outcomes: Key reports clearly separates company disclosure from external analyst views and never fabricates a report or URL.
Organisation Overview distinguishes unresolved facts from available evidence awaiting governed extraction.
BT shows no duplicate programme or Ai Pressure source wording and shows up to three supplied Opportunity watchpoints.
unchanged_areas: Protected: 308 Relationship candidates; working Enterprise identity lineage and associations; 13 Programmes; 17 Opportunities; factual dimension isolation; candidate governance.
required_test_steps: Check Executive Intelligence: no duplicate cost programme; no Ai Pressure schema wording; meaningful dated Watchpoints.
Open Financial Position / Key Reports and confirm the latest supplied BT financial reporting is visible.
Confirm no external analyst report is invented when none is supplied.
Confirm Organisation Overview distinguishes unresolved facts from evidence available for further extraction.
fresh_import_policy: NO — the implementation is a read-only projection of existing candidate Evidence, facts and Opportunity timing.
known_limitations: TEL-001 supplies no qualifying BT external analyst, broker, equity-research or market-research report; the runtime therefore shows a truthful empty state.
Evidence availability does not promote unextracted report content into canonical Enterprise facts.
Enterprise Economics and Leadership / Governance remain architectural intent, not independently implemented TEL-001 runtime dimensions.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in the focused evidence-utilisation, Executive Enterprise Intelligence and TEL-001 regression suites.

operator_validation_status: PASS — six Enterprise dossier routes rendered from canonical facts and associations
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
